exact_holds.reason: ANSI/VITA 65.0/46.0/46.30/.31/48.2/.4/.8/62.0/66.x/67.x and companion originals referenced by C239 but not read in this packet
Original hardware diagrams/cross-sectional/overlays read at caption and labels, not visually verified pixel geometry
VBAT/ALT_VBAT pins and electrical limits do not prove a battery, source chemistry, current charge, current power path or manufacturer installation
100mm short 3U 1.2-in pitch and standard 160mm 1-in pitch differ; no universal intermateability or chassis
Conduction, airflow and liquid cooling use different slot profiles; adapted installations conditional, not necessarily plug-compatible
PSC has distinct input, output, return/sense/control, keying and management pins; table is electrical design, not field telemetry
Primary PIC signals traverse backplane except enumerated front-panel exceptions, not a general external sensor cable or DIM child graph
Maintenance Console Port is service/debug UART, not normal sensing or CSAPI operational command channel
Certificate of Volatility describes vendor memories and protection, and CoV original remains absent for four cases
Original §13.2.10 says embedded undocumented NVM may escape CoV inventory; cannot certify full memory sanitization
13.2.4.2-9 repeats Table13.2.4.2-1; ALT_VBATT vs ALT_VBAT, 100m caption, –DC/CAN vs –DC/ACN inconsistent originals preserved
Security overlay rules referenced in restricted Appendix C, not audited; no inferred high assurance certification
Only §13.2.10 CoV continuation on PDF230 source-read; next §13.2.11 not audited
No new domain name, hardware root, DIM class/cardinality, Profile SHALL, vendor conformance or device execution adopted
